state_space: Normalized active E=imP rank14 under original Euclidean metric; h_J defined on E

required_inputs.overlaps: Endpoint h_J(y0,y128) and128 adjacent h_J(yj,yj+1); each complex value consists of real and J-quadrature channels
required_inputs.complex_error_meaning: Euclidean norm of the two real channel errors, not a separate allowance per channel
required_inputs.clock: Bounded native window and sample gaps; no physical seconds map

gating.state_space_verification: Active normalization and coherent comparison-frame preconditions require separate acquisition checks; phase function alone cannot verify them

assumptions.statement: Original active rank14 filled-tetrahedron carrier, ascending orientations, Euclidean metric and J=A/2; snapshots are normalized active states.
Retain ordinary U1 ray quotient, Hermitian h_J(u,v)=<u,v>+i<Ju,v>, and alpha=<Jy,dy>; physical interpretation is not established.
Commuting local gain family g_k(s)K_k; reference gains(1,1,3/2); independent absolute gain error<=1/100, including bounded piecewise-continuous drift.
Reference preparation(y_edge01+y_top)/sqrt2 with active Euclidean perturbation<=1/10; corresponding normalized ray used.
Window T0=2pi chosen from exposed reference candidate; actual |T-T0|<=1/100 in native units;128links with each gap<=T_plus/128.
Full-carrier coherent endpoint/adjacent overlap access, including hidden plane, normalized joint complex error<=1/1000 endpoint and1/1000000 eachlink; deterministic bounds not measured capabilities.
Measured overlap coordinates transform covariantly with their snapshot phase frames; required active-space and calibration preconditions are external to the phase gate.

guarantee.baseline: Q0=exp(-2pi*i*r_hidden) for the same actual preparation at reference gains/window
guarantee.central_preparation: Q0=-1; phase not constant across preparation ball

memory: Initial reference, previous/current normalized state and running phasor suffice for streaming; reference coherence and sensor/noise costs OPEN
rate_correction: No actual or nominal rates supplied to estimator; continuous correction replaced by observed links with discretization bound
